command.name: security key-manager external azure update-config
command.description: This command provides a way to update advanced attributes of an Azure Key Vault (AKV) configuration. The -config-name parameter can optionally be set to specify a specific AKV configuration of the given Vserver. If the -config-name parameter is not provided, the credentials of the given Vserver's enabled configuration are updated.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver of the AKV configuration to be updated.

parameter.name: config-name
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the name of the AKV configuration to be updated.

parameter.name: port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the port of the deployed AKV.

parameter.name: oauth-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Open-Authorization host of the deployed AKV.

parameter.name: proxy-type
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy type.

parameter.name: proxy-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy host.

parameter.name: proxy-port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy port.

parameter.name: proxy-username
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy username.

parameter.name: proxy-password
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy password.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the timeout, in seconds, for attempting to connect to the deployed AKV.

parameter.name: client-id
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the client (application) ID of the deployed Azure application.

parameter.name: tenant-id
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the tenant (directory) ID of the deployed Azure application.

example.p: The following example updates the port number for the AKV configuration "config1" associated with the data Vserver v1.
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager external azure update-config -vserver v1 -config-name config1 -port 2333
